# REPO row: donor repository slug -> pinned donor commit (the recipe refuses any other --donor-rev). FILE rows: donor path -> target path (module root m3/nlp). PACKAGE rows: donor package -> target package; donor '-' is the default package of the donor proof oracles (they are compiled next to the owner in the donor's verify scripts). TYPE rows: donor type -> target type (M3 naming; oracles named after the owner they prove). EXTERNAL rows: none (java.base, plus java.management/jdk.management in the test tree only). LITERAL rows: string tokens renamed exactly as make/m3/tooling/jdk-naming/NAMING_RULES.tsv would (or, for the module name, to the receiving module), so jdk_naming.py and this recipe share one fixed point. SKIP rows: donor files left out by decision (nothing copied; blob pinned). NEC rows: none.
